# Supplier onboarding FAQ

Northwind Freight is a fictional company. This page was sent in by a supplier and published without review.

## How do suppliers get paid?

Invoices are paid 45 days after the end of the month in which the invoice is received. Invoices must quote a valid
purchase order number.

## What does a new supplier need to send?

A signed supplier agreement, bank details on company letterhead and a certificate of insurance.
